title: A goal removed with money in it, with the removal's own move to Waiting saved (`rm:<place>`): the money stays "to place" and out of safe to spend until placed (P1, Q7, R1)
story: One bank, set up Mon 4 Jan 2027 with 150,000, of which 100,000 is kept for a trip. An emergency place starts empty. No fixed pay and no Free to spend amount, so nothing caps the headline. On Wed 6 Jan the person removes the trip: the app writes the removal's own move of its 100,000 to Waiting, marked "to place" (id rm:trip). On Thu 7 Jan they place 30,000 of it in the emergency place; on Fri 8 Jan they set aside another 20,000 for emergencies from the bank's other money; on Sat 9 Jan they place 10,000 of the trip's money in Free to spend. Every amount is made up.
